title: Class Components Applied Check
description: Practice class state updates, lifecycle cleanup, this binding, and migration decisions.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: A class method handleClick is passed as onClick={this.handleClick} and this is undefined inside it. What is a common fix?

options.text: Bind it in the constructor or define it as a class field arrow method

questions.explanation: Binding or arrow class fields preserve the intended component instance as this.

questions.prompt: A class increments count with this.setState({ count: this.state.count + 1 }) twice in one event. What is safer?

options.text: Use functional setState based on previous state

questions.explanation: Functional setState avoids stale state when updates are batched.

questions.prompt: A class starts an interval in componentDidMount. What should it do? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Start a new interval in render

questions.explanation: External resources created by lifecycle methods should be cleaned up on unmount.

questions.prompt: A class fetches data when props.userId changes. Where should it compare previous and current props?
questions.explanation: componentDidUpdate receives previous props/state and is the place to react to relevant updates.

questions.prompt: Nested class state can be mutated directly because setState shallowly merges top-level keys.
questions.explanation: Nested state still needs immutable updates; shallow merging does not make direct mutation safe.

questions.prompt: When migrating a class with componentDidMount, componentDidUpdate, and componentWillUnmount subscription logic, which function component tool is most relevant?
questions.explanation: An effect can set up, update, and clean up a subscription based on dependencies.

questions.prompt: Which are valid reasons to keep understanding class components? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Using error boundaries in current React patterns
Because hooks do not support state

questions.explanation: Class components remain important for legacy maintenance, lifecycle literacy, and common error boundary implementations.

questions.prompt: A class passes onClick={this.deleteItem(id)} and deletion happens during render. What is the fix?

options.text: Pass a function, such as onClick={() => this.deleteItem(id)}

questions.explanation: Calling the method during render executes it immediately; pass a callback for React to call later.
